achievement.streak.description: Achievement: a streak of this many days.

ai.budget.message: You've used today's AI help. It comes back tomorrow.
ai.budget.description: The learner's daily allowance of AI calls is spent.

ai.explain.button.description: Button after a wrong answer: ask a language model why the answer was wrong.

ai.explain.by.message: Written by a language model ({$model}). It can be wrong.
ai.explain.by.description: Under every AI explanation: which model wrote it. $model is a technical model name, left as is.

ai.explain.failed.message: No explanation this time. Try again later.
ai.explain.failed.description: When the model gave no usable explanation.

ai.explain.loading.description: Status while the explanation is being written.

ai.explain.rate.description: Label of the rating buttons under an explanation.

ai.explain.title.description: Heading of an explanation of the learner's mistake, written by a language model.

ai.explain.unhelpful.description: Rating button: the explanation did not help.

ai.judge.accepted.message: On second look, your answer is accepted. It counts as right.
ai.judge.accepted.description: The language model accepted an answer graded wrong; the learner's progress is updated.

ai.judge.checking.description: Status while a language model checks an answer the accepted answers did not list.

ai.judge.queued.message: Your answer will be checked again when you're back online.
ai.judge.queued.description: Offline: the second check waits for a connection.

ai.report.button.message: My answer should have been accepted
ai.report.button.description: Button after an answer graded wrong: the learner says it is right. It counts as right for them at once and goes to review.

ai.report.done.message: Counted as right. A reviewer will look at your answer too.
ai.report.done.description: Confirmation after the learner said their answer should have been accepted.

ai.report.reject.description: Button after an answer graded right: the learner says it should not have been accepted. It counts as wrong for them at once and goes to review.

ai.report.rejected.message: Counted as wrong. A reviewer will look at it too.
ai.report.rejected.description: Confirmation after the learner said their answer should have been wrong.

ai.report.spoken.description: Button under the feedback of a speaking exercise the device scored as wrong: the learner says they said the sentence right (tone and sound scoring can be wrong). It counts as right at once, and a reviewer looks at it.

ai.roleplay.character.description: Label: the character the language model plays.

ai.roleplay.goal.description: Label: what the learner tries to do in the conversation.

ai.roleplay.log.description: Accessible name of the list of conversation turns.

ai.roleplay.no-turn.message: No reply came back in words you know. Try saying it another way.
ai.roleplay.no-turn.description: Every generated turn failed the vocabulary check; nothing unchecked is shown.

ai.roleplay.setting.description: Label: where the roleplay conversation takes place.

ai.roleplay.show-translation.description: Button: show the translation of the character's line.

ai.roleplay.start.description: Button: ask the character to speak first.

ai.roleplay.them.description: Speaker label on the character's turns (played by a language model).

ai.roleplay.thinking.description: Status while the model writes the next turn.

ai.roleplay.you.description: Speaker label on the learner's own turns.

ai.roleplay.your-turn.description: Label of the field where the learner writes their turn.

ai.unavailable.message: The language model can't be reached right now.
ai.unavailable.description: AI help failed because the model service is unreachable.

app.account.age.description: Label of the age field, shown only when the server asks for an age before it creates an account (an age gate). Ask neutrally: never hint at a minimum age.

app.account.age-note.message: In years. The server checks it and doesn't keep it.

app.account.age-refused.message: This server can't create an account for you. You can keep learning on this device: your progress stays here.
app.account.age-refused.description: Shown when the server's age gate turned the person away. Neutral: it does not say why or name an age. Learning without an account always works.

app.account.create.description: Button that creates an account and uploads the progress on this device.

app.account.data.description: Heading of the section that downloads or deletes what the server keeps for the account.

app.account.delete.description: Button that opens the form for deleting the account and its data on the server.

app.account.delete-cancel.description: Button that closes the delete-account form without deleting anything.

app.account.delete-confirm.description: Button that deletes the account and its data on the server. It cannot be undone.

app.account.delete-note.message: This deletes your account and everything the server keeps for it: your synced progress, your profile and your league places. It cannot be undone. Your progress on this device stays. Enter your password to confirm.
app.account.delete-note.description: Explains what deleting the account does, above the password field that confirms it.

app.account.deleted.message: Your account is deleted, with its data on the server. Your progress on this device stays.
app.account.deleted.description: Shown after the account was deleted.

app.account.email.description: Label of the email address field.

app.account.export.description: Button that downloads, as one file, everything the server keeps for the account.

app.account.have-account.description: Switches the account form to signing in.

app.account.new-account.description: Switches the account form to creating an account.

app.account.password-hint.description: Hint under the new-password field. $min is the minimum number of characters.

app.account.pitch.message: Create an account to keep your progress safe and use it on your other devices. Everything you've done so far comes with you.
app.account.pitch.description: Introduces the optional account. Accounts are never required.

app.account.sign-in.description: Button that signs in to an existing account.

app.account.sign-out.description: Button that signs out. Progress stays on this device.

app.account.signed-in.description: Who is signed in. $email is the account's email address.

app.account.welcome-back.message: Sign in to bring your progress from your other devices.

app.course.drafts.description: A note on a course's page in the demo: how many of its sentences (story lines included) no native speaker has signed off yet, of all of them (ADR 0073). A release build has none, so it never shows there.

app.error.account.age-required.message: This server asks for your age before it creates an account.
app.error.account.age-required.description: Shown when the server needs the person's age to create an account; the age field appears with it.

app.error.account.email-taken.message: There's already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
app.error.account.email-taken.description: Shown when creating an account with an email that has one.

app.error.account.invalid-age.message: Enter your age in years, as a number.
app.error.account.invalid-age.description: Shown when the age field holds something other than a whole number.

app.error.account.invalid-email.description: Shown when the email address is not valid.

app.error.account.rate-limited.message: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
app.error.account.rate-limited.description: Shown when the server refuses more sign-ins or sign-ups for a while.

app.error.account.rejected.message: The server didn't accept some of your progress.
app.error.account.rejected.description: Shown when the server rejects uploaded events.

app.error.account.signed-out.message: You've been signed out. Sign in again to keep syncing.
app.error.account.signed-out.description: Shown when the server no longer accepts the saved sign-in.

app.error.account.unknown.description: Shown for unexpected account or sync errors.

app.error.account.unreachable.message: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app.error.account.unreachable.description: Shown when the sync server cannot be reached.

app.error.account.weak-password.description: Shown when a new password is too short. $min is the minimum number of characters.

app.error.account.wrong-credentials.message: That email and password don't match.

app.error.load.message: This course could not be loaded.
app.error.load.description: Shown when a course bundle fails to load.

app.error.profile.characters.message: Usernames can only use letters, digits and _ - . between them.
app.error.profile.characters.description: Username has characters that are not allowed.

app.error.profile.display-name.message: That display name can't be used.
app.error.profile.display-name.description: Display name is empty, too long, or has control characters.

app.error.profile.length.message: That username is too short or too long.
app.error.profile.length.description: Username has fewer than 3 or more than 30 characters.

app.error.profile.mixed-script.message: That username mixes writing systems in a way that could mislead. Try one script.
app.error.profile.mixed-script.description: Username mixes scripts beyond what UTS #39 Moderately Restrictive allows.

app.error.profile.separators.message: Put _ - or . only between letters or digits, one at a time.
app.error.profile.separators.description: Username starts or ends with a separator, or has two in a row.

app.error.profile.username-confusable.message: That username looks too much like one that's taken.
app.error.profile.username-confusable.description: The username's confusable skeleton matches a taken one.

app.home.writing.description: Label of the choice between a course's orthographies (e.g. Latin or Cyrillic for Uzbek).

app.lessons.back.description: Link back to the course list.

app.lessons.lesson.description: Name of a lesson in the list. $number is its position.

app.lessons.new-words.description: Accessible label of the preview of words a lesson introduces.

app.lessons.title.description: Heading of a course's lesson list.

app.listening.off.message: Listening exercises are off for now. They come back in an hour.
app.listening.off.description: Notice on the course path after the learner chose 'Can't listen now'.

app.listening.on.description: Button that brings listening exercises back right away.

app.offline.core-missing.message: Download this course to use it with no connection.
app.offline.core-missing.description: Nothing of the course is stored on the device yet.

app.offline.core-ready.message: This course's lessons work on this device with no connection. Download audio and pictures to have them offline too.
app.offline.core-ready.description: The course's text is stored on the device; media are downloaded per unit.

app.offline.download.description: Button: download one unit's audio and pictures. $size is already formatted (e.g. 612 kB).

app.offline.download-all.description: Button: download the whole course for offline use. $size is already formatted.

app.offline.downloading.description: Label of the download progress bar.

app.offline.error.integrity.message: A file did not arrive intact, so it was not kept. Try again.
app.offline.error.integrity.description: A downloaded file did not match the course's checksum.

app.offline.error.network.message: The download stopped because the connection was lost. Try again when you are online.

app.offline.error.quota.message: There is not enough storage on this device for this download.
app.offline.error.quota.description: The browser refused to store more.

app.offline.notice.message: You are offline. Lessons on this device still work, and your progress is saved here and syncs when you are back online.
app.offline.notice.description: Shown while the device has no network.

app.offline.progress.description: Download progress; both values are already formatted sizes.

app.offline.remove.description: Button: delete a unit's audio and pictures from the device (what other units also use stays). $size is the space it frees, already formatted.

app.offline.state.missing.description: A unit with none of its audio and pictures on the device.

app.offline.state.partial.description: A unit with some of its audio and pictures on the device.

app.offline.state.ready.description: A unit whose audio and pictures are all on the device.

app.offline.title.description: Heading of the course's offline section (Phase 10).

app.offline.unavailable.message: This course is not on this device yet. Open it once while you are online to use it offline.
app.offline.unavailable.description: Opening a course that is not stored, with no network.

app.offline.unit.description: Name of a unit without a title, by its position in the course.

app.path.done.description: Status of a lesson the learner has completed. They can still open it to practise.

app.path.locked.description: Status of a lesson that opens once the lesson before it is done.

app.path.start.description: Status of the next lesson to do.

app.path.story.description: Label on a story node of the learning path; the story's title follows it.

app.practice.back.description: Link from an empty practice session back to the course path.

app.practice.due.description: How many word facets are due for review. $count is a number.

app.practice.empty.description: Shown when a review or mistakes session has no exercises.

app.practice.mistakes.description: Button that starts a session of the learner's recent mistakes.

app.practice.placement.message: Already know some {$language}? Find your level
app.practice.placement.description: Link to a short placement test, shown before any lesson is done. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

app.practice.review.description: Button that starts a review session of words that are due.

app.practice.title.description: Heading above the review and mistakes buttons.

app.practice.to-fix.description: How many recent mistakes are waiting in the mistakes session. $count is a number.

app.profile.display-name.description: Label of the display name field.

app.profile.saved.description: Shown after the profile is saved.

app.profile.username-hint.message: 3 to 30 letters or digits, with _ - or . between them.

app.progress.device.message: Your progress is saved on this device.
app.progress.device.description: Where progress is kept when there is no account.

app.progress.export.description: Button that downloads every learning event recorded on this device.

app.progress.title.description: Heading of the progress and account section on the home screen.

app.reminders.denied.message: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
app.reminders.denied.description: Shown when the browser denied notification permission.

app.reminders.failed.message: This device could not sign up for reminders. Try again later.
app.reminders.failed.description: The phone's push service refused to register the app (Android or iOS).

app.reminders.hint.message: At most one a day, around the time you usually practise, and only if you haven't yet.

app.reminders.label.description: Switch that turns practice reminders (push notifications) on or off.

app.reminders.unsupported.description: Shown when the browser has no push support.

app.reset.cancel.description: Closes the confirmation without changing anything.

app.reset.confirm-body.message: Every lesson but the first will be locked again, and words come back as new. This applies on all your devices and cannot be undone. Your streak, XP and achievements stay.
app.reset.confirm-body.description: Body of the confirmation dialog: what starting over does and does not change.

app.reset.confirm-title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog. $language is the course's name.

app.reset.done.description: Status after starting over. $language is the course's name.

app.reset.hint.message: Go back to the beginning of {$language}: the lessons, the words you know and your mistakes. Your streak and XP stay.
app.reset.hint.description: Explains starting over. $language is the course's name, already in the UI language.

app.reset.open.description: Button that opens the confirmation for starting the course over.

app.reset.title.description: Heading of the course page's section for starting the course over.

app.reset.type-hint.message: Capital letters and accents do not matter.
app.reset.type-hint.description: Hint under the field where the learner types the course's name to confirm starting over. Letter case and accent marks are ignored there: mention only what your script has (a script without capital letters need not mention them).

app.reset.type-label.description: Label of the field where the learner types the course's name to confirm starting over. $language is the course's name, already in the UI language.

app.roleplay.back.description: Link from a conversation back to the course path.

app.roleplay.note.message: A language model plays the other person, using only words you know. It can make mistakes.
app.roleplay.note.description: Explains roleplay before the list of scenarios.

app.roleplay.title.description: Course page heading: roleplay scenarios with a character played by a language model.

app.roleplay.unavailable.message: Conversations need an account and a server with a language model.
app.roleplay.unavailable.description: Shown on a conversation page when roleplay is not available.

app.speaking.off.message: Speaking exercises are off for now. They come back in an hour.
app.speaking.off.description: Notice on the course path after the learner chose 'Can't speak now'.

app.speaking.on.description: Button that brings speaking exercises back right away.

app.store.memory.message: This browser window can't save your progress. It will be lost when you close it.
app.store.memory.description: Shown when on-device storage is unavailable (for example in some private windows).

app.sync.mismatch.message: The server's copy of your progress doesn't match this device's.
app.sync.mismatch.description: Shown when the server's projection of the log differs from the device's own.

app.sync.offline.description: Sync status while the server cannot be reached. $count is how many events wait to upload.

app.sync.pending.description: Sync status with events not yet uploaded. $count is a number.

app.sync.saved.message: All progress saved to your account
app.sync.saved.description: Sync status when everything is uploaded.

app.voice.forget.description: Button: delete the pitch range this device learned (used to judge tones).

app.voice.forgotten.description: Confirmation after the voice range is deleted.

app.voice.note.message: Recordings are scored, then dropped. They are never kept, on this device or on a server.

app.voice.server.message: Check words and sounds on the server
app.voice.server.description: Switch: send recordings to the server's speech service (scored in memory, never kept).

app.voice.title.description: Settings heading: speaking exercises and privacy.

app.xp.today.description: Experience points earned today (the learner's local date). XP: experience points, often left as XP.

app.xp.total.description: Total experience points in this course. XP: experience points, often left as XP.

audio.check.back.description: Audio check: link back to the course page.

audio.check.cer.description: Audio check: the speech recognizer's character error rate for the clip, from 0 (heard exactly) up.

audio.check.export.description: Audio check: button that saves the listener's verdicts as a file for `nabu audio verdicts`. $count is how many.

audio.check.filter.kind.description: Audio check: label of the filter by kind of item.

audio.check.filter.mine.description: Audio check: label of the filter by the listener's own verdict.

audio.check.filter.order.description: Audio check: label of the sort order.

audio.check.filter.status.description: Audio check: label of the filter by how the speech recognizer check went.

audio.check.filter.voice.description: Audio check: label of the filter by the voice that made the clips (shown when a course has clips from more than one voice).

audio.check.heard.description: Audio check: label before what the speech recognizer heard in the clip (shown in the course's language).

audio.check.held.description: Audio check: badge on an item the learners' app does not play, because its clip failed the check or a listener rejected it.

audio.check.intro.message: Every clip of this course, with what the speech recognizer heard when it was made. Listen, and say whether each one sounds right. Your verdicts stay on this device until you download them.
audio.check.intro.description: Audio check: explanation under the heading.

audio.check.keys.message: Keys: J and K move between items, Space plays, S plays slowly, R says it sounds right, W says it sounds wrong.
audio.check.keys.description: Audio check: keyboard shortcuts, shown under the filters. Name the keys as they are on the keyboard (J, K, Space, S, R, W).

audio.check.kind.all.description: Audio check: filter option, every kind of item.

audio.check.kind.line.description: Audio check: filter option and badge, a line of a story.

audio.check.kind.sentence.description: Audio check: filter option and badge, a sentence.

audio.check.kind.word.description: Audio check: filter option and badge, a word (a vocabulary item).

audio.check.loading.description: Audio check: shown while the list of clips loads.

audio.check.mine.all.description: Audio check: filter option, whatever the listener said.

audio.check.mine.none.description: Audio check: filter option, items the listener has not judged.

audio.check.missing.message: This site has no audio check for this course.
audio.check.missing.description: Audio check: the page could not load the course's list of clips (it is published with the demo, not with the app).

audio.check.note.description: Audio check: label of the optional note a listener writes when a clip sounds wrong.

audio.check.open.description: Debug mode: link on the course page to the audio check, a page listing every clip of the course to listen to and judge.

audio.check.order.course.description: Audio check: sort option, unit by unit as the course runs.

audio.check.order.worst.description: Audio check: sort option, highest speech recognizer error rate first.

audio.check.other.message: Not in the course any more
audio.check.other.description: Audio check: heading of clips whose sentence or word the course no longer has.

audio.check.outdated.message: You judged an earlier version of this clip.
audio.check.outdated.description: Audio check: the clip was made again after the listener judged it; the old verdict no longer applies.

audio.check.read.description: Audio check: label before the text the voice was given, when it differs from the text shown (vowel marks added, for instance).

audio.check.reference.description: Audio check: label of the recording every clip's voice imitates (a cloning voice clones one reference).

audio.check.rejected.description: Audio check: badge on a clip a person has listened to and rejected.

audio.check.reviewed.description: Audio check: badge on a clip a person has listened to and approved.

audio.check.right.description: Audio check: toggle button, the listener says the clip sounds right.

audio.check.shown.description: Audio check: how many items the filters show, out of all.

audio.check.stats.description: Audio check: heading of the counts of clips by how the speech recognizer check went.

audio.check.status.all.description: Audio check: filter option, any result of the speech recognizer check.

audio.check.status.fail.description: Audio check: the speech recognizer heard something else.

audio.check.status.none.description: Audio check: the clip was never checked by the speech recognizer.

audio.check.status.pass.description: Audio check: the speech recognizer heard what the clip should say.

audio.check.status.review.description: Audio check: the speech recognizer heard something close; a person should listen.

audio.check.title.description: Heading of the audio check page: every clip of a course, to listen to and judge.

audio.check.unit.description: Audio check: heading of a unit without a title.

audio.check.voice.description: Audio check: which voice made the clips. $voice is the course's voice id, $provider the speech synthesizer's technical name (navoiy, omnivoice, espeak-ng); neither is translated.

audio.check.voice.all.description: Audio check: voice filter option that shows every voice's clips.

audio.check.voice.option.description: Audio check: a voice in the voice filter. $name is the course's name for the voice (e.g. toshkent), $provider the speech engine (e.g. navoiy, espeak-ng); both are identifiers, not translated.

audio.check.voice.recorded.description: Audio check: voice filter option for clips a person recorded rather than a speech engine.

audio.check.wrong.description: Audio check: toggle button, the listener says the clip sounds wrong.

corrections.cancel.description: Button that closes the correction form without saving.

corrections.choose.description: Heading of the list of a match-the-pairs exercise's words, each with its meaning: the learner picks the one to correct.

corrections.edit.description: Button in place of corrections.mark when the learner already suggested a correction for this sentence or line.

corrections.error.empty.description: Error under a field the learner emptied.

corrections.error.too-long.description: Error under a field that is longer than allowed.

corrections.error.unchanged.message: Change something, or write a note for the reviewer.
corrections.error.unchanged.description: Error when the learner sends the form without changing anything.

corrections.export.description: Button on the sentence list: save the corrections this device made to this course as a file a reviewer can apply. $count is how many.

corrections.intro.message: Change whatever is wrong: the text, how a word is read, or the translation. A reviewer checks every correction before it reaches the course.
corrections.intro.description: Explanation at the top of the correction form.

corrections.mark.description: Button under an exercise's feedback, in the sentence list, and on a story line: open the form to say what is wrong with the sentence or line.

corrections.mark.pairs.description: Button under the feedback of a match-the-pairs exercise: choose which word or meaning is wrong, then say what it should be.

corrections.mark.word.description: Button under the feedback of an exercise about a word (its form or its meaning): open the form to say what is wrong with it.

corrections.note.description: Label of a free-text field: anything the learner wants the reviewer to know.

corrections.now.description: Precedes the sentence as the course has it, under the field where the learner corrects it.

corrections.page.back.description: Link from the sentence list back to the course page.

corrections.page.intro.message: Every sentence and story line in this course, unit by unit. If one is wrong, mark it and say what it should be.
corrections.page.intro.description: Explanation at the top of the sentence list.

corrections.page.open.description: Link on the course page to the list of every sentence and story line, where learners can mark one as wrong.

corrections.page.story.description: Label before a story's title in the sentence list, above its lines.

corrections.page.title.description: Heading of the page listing every sentence and story line of a course.

corrections.page.unit.description: Name of a unit that has no title. $number counts units from 1.

corrections.page.units.description: Accessible name of the list of units to choose from on the sentence list.

corrections.pending.description: Badge on a sentence or story line the learner has already suggested a correction for.

corrections.readings.description: Heading over the fields holding each word's pinned reading (for Cantonese, Jyutping).

corrections.sent.message: Thanks! A reviewer will check your correction.
corrections.sent.description: Confirmation after a correction is recorded.

corrections.text.description: Label of the field holding the sentence or line in one orthography. $orthography is that orthography's name (corrections can change every orthography a course is taught in).

corrections.translation.description: Label of the field holding the sentence's translation into the learner's language.

corrections.word.intro.message: Change whatever is wrong: the word, how it is read, or what it means. A reviewer checks every correction before it reaches the course.
corrections.word.intro.description: Explanation at the top of the correction form for a word.

corrections.word.meaning.description: Label of the field holding what the word means in the learner's language (its gloss).

corrections.word.text.description: Label of the field holding the word in one orthography. $orthography is that orthography's name (a course can be taught in several).

course.name.apc.description: Name of the Lebanese Arabic (apc) course, used inside other messages as $language. Not 'Levantine': the course teaches the Lebanese variety.

course.name.fa.description: Name of the Persian (fa) course, used inside other messages as $language.

course.name.uz.description: Name of the Uzbek (uz) course, used inside other messages as $language.

course.name.yue.description: Name of the Cantonese (yue) course, used inside other messages as $language.

debug.cards.back.description: Debug mode: link from the card gallery back to the course page.

debug.cards.intro.message: One card of each kind this course can make. Nothing you do here is recorded or counts towards your progress.
debug.cards.intro.description: Debug mode: explanation at the top of the card gallery.

debug.cards.none.description: Debug mode: shown for a kind of card the course has no material for.

debug.cards.open.description: Debug mode: link on the course page to a page with one card of every kind.

debug.cards.play-all.description: Debug mode: button that plays one card of every kind in a row.

debug.cards.title.description: Debug mode: heading of the page with one card of every kind the course can make.

debug.cards.try.description: Debug mode: button that plays one card of this kind.

debug.template.description: Debug mode: under a card's instruction, which kind of card it is. $template is its technical id (gap-fill, translate-tap.l1-l2…), not translated.

exercise.action.check.description: Button that submits the answer for grading.

exercise.action.play-audio.description: Accessible label of the speaker button.

exercise.action.quit.description: Accessible label of the close (×) button in the lesson header.

exercise.action.skip.description: Button that skips the current exercise.

exercise.answer.input-label.description: Label of the free-text answer field. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

exercise.answer.label.description: Accessible label of the row where chosen word tiles appear.

exercise.instruction.write-in.description: Instruction for a translate-into-the-target-language exercise. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

exercise.progress.description: Accessible value of the lesson progress bar. $current and $total are counts.

exercise.prompt.label.description: Accessible label of the sentence the learner translates.

exercise.readings.toggle.description: Switch that shows or hides pronunciation guides (Jyutping, vowel marks) above the text.

exercise.wordbank.label.description: Accessible label of the group of word tiles to choose from.

exercise.wordbank.remaining.description: How many tiles are still in the word bank. $count is a number.

feedback.note.alef-maqsura.message: Watch the alif maqsura (ى) at the end of the word.
feedback.note.alef-maqsura.description: Feedback note for Arabic: alif maqsura and ya were confused.

feedback.note.apostrophe.message: In Uzbek, oʻ and gʻ take a turned comma (ʻ) and the separator sign is ʼ. A plain ' is fine to type, though.
feedback.note.apostrophe.description: Feedback note for Uzbek: the learner typed a plain apostrophe.

feedback.note.contrast-case.message: The ending changes the word's role in the sentence (to, at, from, of…), not just its spelling.
feedback.note.contrast-case.description: Feedback note: the answer has a different case ending (for example Uzbek -ga for -da), which changes the meaning.

feedback.note.contrast-person.message: The ending changes who it is about (I, you, we…), not just its spelling.
feedback.note.contrast-person.description: Feedback note: the answer has a different person ending (for example Uzbek -san for -man), which changes the meaning.

feedback.note.contrast-possessive.message: The ending changes whose it is (my, your, his…), not just its spelling.
feedback.note.contrast-possessive.description: Feedback note: the answer has a different possessive ending (for example Uzbek -ing for -im), which changes the meaning.

feedback.note.contrast-pronoun.message: That is a different pronoun, not a typo.
feedback.note.contrast-pronoun.description: Feedback note: the answer has another pronoun one letter or two from the expected one (for example Сен for Мен).

feedback.note.hamza.description: Feedback note for Arabic: a hamza seat was written as a plain alif.

feedback.note.hk-tw-variant.message: This is the Taiwan form of the character; Hong Kong usually writes it differently.
feedback.note.hk-tw-variant.description: Feedback note for Cantonese: a Taiwan character form was used where Hong Kong uses another.

feedback.note.ime-homophone.message: One character has the right sound but is the wrong character: check what your keyboard suggested.
feedback.note.ime-homophone.description: Feedback note for an IME slip (a homophone picked from the input method).

feedback.note.judge.message: Accepted after a second check by a language model.
feedback.note.judge.description: Note on an answer the judge accepted (provisionally right).

feedback.note.marks.message: Check the accents and vowel marks.
feedback.note.marks.description: Feedback note: the answer differs from the expected one only in marks.

feedback.note.pairs-mistakes.message: Some pairs took more than one try.
feedback.note.pairs-mistakes.description: Feedback note after match-pairs when some pairs were mismatched first.

feedback.note.reading-no-tones.message: Each syllable needs its tone number.
feedback.note.reading-no-tones.description: Feedback note: a typed reading (Jyutping) has no tone numbers.

feedback.note.reading-syllables.message: Check the sounds of each syllable.
feedback.note.reading-syllables.description: Feedback note: a typed reading has wrong syllables, or too many or too few.

feedback.note.reading-tone.message: The sounds are right: check the tones.
feedback.note.reading-tone.description: Feedback note: a typed reading has the right syllables with a wrong tone number.

feedback.note.script-mismatch.message: Check that you're writing in the right script.
feedback.note.script-mismatch.description: Generic feedback note: the answer is written in a different script from the course.

feedback.note.spacing.message: Watch the half-space (ZWNJ) inside this word.
feedback.note.spacing.description: Feedback note referenced by orthography profiles (match.zwnj.note = spacing) when the learner typed a space or nothing instead of a zero-width non-joiner.

feedback.note.speech-phones.message: Some sounds were off. It's feedback, not a mark: accents differ.
feedback.note.speech-phones.description: Feedback note: the phone recognizer heard some sounds differently.

feedback.note.speech-silent.description: Feedback note: the recording had no speech.

feedback.note.speech-tone-shapes.message: Some tones went the wrong way: up, down or level.
feedback.note.speech-tone-shapes.description: Feedback note (before calibration): pitch movement differed.

feedback.note.speech-tones.description: Feedback note: some syllables were said with another tone.

feedback.note.speech-words.message: The words didn't come through: compare with the sentence.
feedback.note.speech-words.description: Feedback note: speech recognition heard different words.

feedback.note.ta-marbuta.message: Watch the ta marbuta (ة) at the end of the word.
feedback.note.ta-marbuta.description: Feedback note for Arabic: ta marbuta was written as ha.

feedback.note.tajik-letters.message: Use the Tajik letters ғ, ӣ, қ, ӯ, ҳ and ҷ.
feedback.note.tajik-letters.description: Feedback note for Tajik: Russian-keyboard letters were typed instead of Tajik ones.

feedback.note.use-traditional.description: Feedback note for Cantonese: the answer contains Simplified characters.

feedback.note.uzbek-letters.message: Use the Uzbek letters ў, қ, ғ and ҳ, not у, к, г and х.
feedback.note.uzbek-letters.description: Feedback note for Uzbek in Cyrillic: Russian-keyboard letters were typed instead of Uzbek ones.

feedback.note.variant.message: Another spelling of this character is more usual here.
feedback.note.variant.description: Feedback note: an accepted variant form was used.

feedback.note.vocalize-letters.message: Keep the letters as they are, and only add vowel marks.
feedback.note.vocalize-letters.description: Feedback note: the learner changed the word's letters while adding vowel marks.

feedback.note.vocalize-marks.message: Check the vowel marks on each letter.
feedback.note.vocalize-marks.description: Feedback note: some letters have the wrong vowel marks, or none.

feedback.note.zwnj.message: Watch the half-space (ZWNJ) inside this word.
feedback.note.zwnj.description: Generic feedback note when a zero-width non-joiner was typed as a space or left out.

feedback.verdict.correct.description: Feedback headline: the answer matched the expected one.

feedback.verdict.correct-alt.description: Feedback headline when the learner gave a correct answer other than the main one, which is shown after it.

feedback.verdict.correct-marks.message: Correct, but pay attention to the accents and marks.
feedback.verdict.correct-marks.description: Feedback headline: right apart from diacritics or vowel marks.

feedback.verdict.correct-provisional.message: Looks right! We'll double-check this one.
feedback.verdict.correct-provisional.description: Feedback headline: accepted provisionally by the AI judge; a human will review it.

feedback.verdict.correct-variant.message: Correct, but this form is spelled differently here.
feedback.verdict.correct-variant.description: Feedback headline: right, written with an accepted variant form (e.g. a Taiwan character form in a Hong Kong course).

feedback.verdict.correct-with-typo.description: Feedback headline: right apart from a small typing mistake.

feedback.verdict.partial.message: Almost: a character sounds right but is the wrong one.
feedback.verdict.partial.description: Feedback headline for an IME slip: a homophone was picked from the input method.

feedback.verdict.skipped.description: Feedback headline when the learner skipped the exercise.

feedback.verdict.speech-close.description: Feedback headline after speaking that was nearly right (some tones or sounds off): feedback, not a mark.

feedback.verdict.wrong.description: Feedback headline: the answer is wrong. The correct answer is shown below it.

feedback.verdict.wrong-word.description: Feedback headline: one letter off, but the result is another real word.

game.achievements.none.message: None yet. They come with practice.
game.achievements.none.description: Shown when no achievement is unlocked.

game.freezes.description: Streak freezes held: each covers one missed day automatically.

game.gate.empty.message: You're out for now. Practise reviews or mistakes to refill, or come back a little later.
game.gate.empty.description: Shown instead of a lesson when the gate is empty; practice always stays open.

game.gate.energy.description: Energy left (only on instances that turn the energy gate on).

game.gate.hearts.description: Hearts left (only on instances that turn the hearts gate on).

game.streak.description: The learner's current streak: days in a row with practice. In English the number never makes "day" plural; select on $days if your language needs to.

game.streak.longest.description: The learner's longest streak ever, in days.

game.streak.today-done.description: Shown when today already counts for the streak.

game.streak.today-pending.message: Practise today to keep it going.
game.streak.today-pending.description: Shown when today does not count yet; kind, never guilt-tripping.

game.title.description: Heading of the panel with the streak, freezes, quests and achievements.

league.anonymous.description: Shown for a league member who has not chosen a username.

league.days-left.description: Time left in the league week.

league.join.message: Earn XP this week to join a league.
league.join.description: Shown to a signed-in learner who has not earned league XP this week.

league.tier.description: The learner's league tier this week (1 is the first).

league.xp.description: A member's league XP this week.

league.you.description: Marks the learner's own row in the league table.

league.zone.demote.description: Accessible label of the rows that move down a tier at the end of the week.

league.zone.promote.description: Accessible label of the rows that move up a tier at the end of the week.

orthography.apc-Arab.standard.description: Name of the Lebanese Arabic orthography in Arabic script.

orthography.apc-Latn.arabizi.description: Name of Arabizi, Lebanese Arabic written with Latin letters and digits (7 for ح, 3 for ع, 2 for ء).

orthography.fa-Arab.standard.description: Name of the Persian orthography (Arabic script as used for Persian).

orthography.uz-Cyrl.standard.description: Name of the Uzbek Cyrillic orthography.

orthography.uz-Latn.standard.description: Name of the Uzbek Latin orthography.

orthography.yue-Hant-HK.standard.description: Name of the Hong Kong Cantonese orthography.

player.action.cant-listen.description: Skips listening exercises for now (no sound available). They come back in an hour.

player.action.cant-speak.description: Button that skips speaking exercises for the rest of the lesson.

player.action.continue.description: Button that moves on after feedback.

player.audio.label.description: Accessible label of the area with the play buttons of a listening exercise.

player.audio.play.description: Accessible label of the button that plays the audio.

player.audio.slow.description: Accessible label of the button that plays the audio at a slower speed.

player.audio.synthetic.description: Small label next to the play button when the audio is synthesized speech, not a recording of a person.

player.blank.label.description: Accessible label of the gap in a sentence.

player.chars.label.description: Accessible label of the bar of extra characters (ZWNJ, ʻ, ў…).

player.feedback.marked.description: Short explanation after the learner's marked answer: marked words or characters are the ones that differ. Not shown by colour alone.

player.feedback.solution.description: Label before the correct answer in feedback.

player.feedback.your-answer.description: Label before the learner's own answer, with the wrong parts marked.

player.finished.stopped.description: Heading when the learner quit the lesson.

player.finished.title.description: Heading when the lesson is finished.

player.finished.xp.description: Experience points the session just earned, on the summary screen.

player.instruction.char-read.description: Instruction: choose the reading (e.g. Jyutping) of the word shown.

player.instruction.choose-translation.description: Instruction: choose the translation of the sentence shown.

player.instruction.complete-translation.description: Instruction: type the missing word of the translation.

player.instruction.gap-fill.description: Instruction: choose the word that completes the sentence.

player.instruction.listen-select.description: Instruction: hear a word and choose how it is written.

player.instruction.listen-speak.message: Listen, then say what you heard
player.instruction.listen-speak.description: Instruction: hear a sentence and repeat it aloud.

player.instruction.listen-tap.description: Instruction: hear a sentence and build it from word tiles.

player.instruction.listen-type.description: Instruction: hear a sentence and type it.

player.instruction.match-pairs.description: Instruction: match each word with its meaning.

player.instruction.minimal-pair.message: Listen closely: which word is it?
player.instruction.minimal-pair.description: Instruction: hear one of two words that sound almost the same and choose which one.

player.instruction.reading-disambiguatio.message: How is the highlighted character read here?
player.instruction.reading-disambiguatio.description: Instruction: choose the reading a character with several readings has in this word.

player.instruction.select-image.description: Instruction: pick the picture (and word) that matches the meaning shown.

player.instruction.speak.description: Instruction for a speaking exercise (record yourself, then rate how it went).

player.instruction.speak-scored.description: Instruction: speak the sentence shown; the app listens and gives feedback.

player.instruction.story-arrange.message: Tap the words to make what they say
player.instruction.story-arrange.description: Instruction above a story line's translation and its words as tiles: build the line.

player.instruction.story-choose.description: Instruction above a comprehension question in a story.

player.instruction.story-complete.description: Instruction above the next line of a story, shown with a word missing.

player.instruction.tone-identify.description: Instruction: hear one syllable and pick its tone.

player.instruction.transcribe.message: Write how this word is read
player.instruction.transcribe.description: Instruction: type the reading of a Chinese-character word in Latin letters (e.g. Jyutping).

player.instruction.translate-into-suppor.description: Instruction: build the translation of a target-language sentence from word tiles.

player.instruction.vocalize.description: Instruction: write the short-vowel marks (harakat) into an Arabic-script word.

player.key.mark.064b.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+064B (fathatan) to the answer.

player.key.mark.064c.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+064C (dammatan) to the answer.

player.key.mark.064d.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+064D (kasratan) to the answer.

player.key.mark.064e.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+064E (fatha) to the answer.

player.key.mark.064f.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+064F (damma) to the answer.

player.key.mark.0650.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+0650 (kasra) to the answer.

player.key.mark.0651.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+0651 (shadda) to the answer.

player.key.mark.0652.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+0652 (sukun) to the answer.

player.key.mark.0670.description: Spoken name of the key that adds the Arabic-script mark U+0670 (superscript alef) to the answer.

player.key.zwj.description: Accessible name of the ZWJ key. $short is the key's visible label (player.key.zwj.short) and must stay part of the name (WCAG 2.5.3).

player.key.zwj.short.description: Short visible label of the ZWJ key (the character itself is invisible).

player.key.zwnj.description: Accessible name of the ZWNJ key, which keeps two Persian letters from joining. $short is the key's visible label (player.key.zwnj.short) and must stay part of the name (WCAG 2.5.3).

player.key.zwnj.short.description: Short visible label of the ZWNJ key (the character itself is invisible).

player.listen.type-label.description: Accessible label of the text field of a listening exercise. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

player.meaning.label.description: Accessible label of a word's meaning, shown in the learner's language.

player.options.label.description: Accessible label of the group of answer options.

player.pairs.meanings.description: Accessible label of the column of meanings in match-pairs.

player.pairs.words.description: Accessible label of the column of target-language words in match-pairs. $language is the course name.

player.persons.addressee.f.description: Tag under a prompt in the learner's language: the sentence speaks to one woman, so 'you' takes its feminine singular form in the answer.

player.persons.addressee.m.description: Tag under a prompt in the learner's language: the sentence speaks to one man, so 'you' takes its masculine singular form in the answer.

player.persons.addressee.pl.description: Tag under a prompt in the learner's language: the sentence speaks to several people, so 'you' takes its plural form in the answer.

player.persons.speaker.f.description: Tag under a prompt in the learner's language: the sentence is said by a woman, so the answer uses the forms that agree with a female speaker.

player.persons.speaker.m.description: Tag under a prompt in the learner's language: the sentence is said by a man, so the answer uses the forms that agree with a male speaker (e.g. Arabic adjectives).

player.prompt.hint.description: Accessible label of the support-language translation shown as a hint.

player.prompt.meaning.description: Accessible label of the meaning (gloss) the learner matches a picture to.

player.quit.body.message: You'll lose your progress in this lesson.

player.quit.cancel.description: Button that closes the quit dialog and goes back to the lesson.

player.quit.title.description: Title of the dialog shown when the learner closes a lesson.

player.speak.play.description: Button that plays back what the learner recorded.

player.speak.rate.description: Heading above the self-rating buttons (speak tier 0).

player.speak.rate.again.description: Self-rating: the learner could not say it.

player.speak.rate.good.description: Self-rating: the learner thinks they said it well.

player.speak.record.description: Button that starts recording the learner's voice.

player.speak.recording.description: Status while the microphone is recording.

player.speak.unavailable.message: Recording isn't available here. You can still say it aloud and rate yourself.
player.speak.unavailable.description: Shown when the browser cannot record audio.

player.speech.calibrating.message: Your tones will be judged fully once the app has heard a little more of your voice.
player.speech.calibrating.description: Before a calibration: only the direction of each tone (rising, falling, level) is judged.

player.speech.checking.description: Status while the recording is scored (on the device, and on the server when it has a speech service).

player.speech.contour-off.description: After a syllable: the pitch movement it should have; $expected is one of player.speech.contour.*.

player.speech.contour.falling.description: Pitch movement of a syllable: goes down.

player.speech.contour.level.description: Pitch movement of a syllable: stays level.

player.speech.contour.rising.description: Pitch movement of a syllable: goes up.

player.speech.heard.description: Label before what speech recognition heard.

player.speech.partial.message: We heard only part of it. Try saying the whole sentence, a little slower.
player.speech.partial.description: After a recording that had speech, but too little of it to find every syllable of the sentence (for example only its first word).

player.speech.rate-instead.description: Heading of the self-rating fallback when recording is not possible.

player.speech.silent.message: We didn't hear anything. Check your microphone and try again.
player.speech.silent.description: No speech was found in the recording; nothing was graded.

player.speech.tone-off.description: After a syllable (shown before it): the tone heard and the tone expected, as tone numbers.

player.toggle.marks.description: Switch that shows or hides harakat (Arabic-script vowel marks and shadda).

player.toggle.vertical.description: Switch that sets the sentence and word tiles top to bottom (CJK).

player.tone.yue-jyutping.1.description: Cantonese tone 1 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.tone.yue-jyutping.2.description: Cantonese tone 2 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.tone.yue-jyutping.3.description: Cantonese tone 3 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.tone.yue-jyutping.4.description: Cantonese tone 4 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.tone.yue-jyutping.5.description: Cantonese tone 5 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.tone.yue-jyutping.6.description: Cantonese tone 6 (Jyutping), with its pitch shape.

player.transcribe.label.description: Label of the field where the learner types a word's reading in Latin letters.

player.transcribe.label.jyutping.description: Label of the field where the learner types a Cantonese word's reading in Jyutping.

player.vocalize.label.message: The word with its vowel marks
player.vocalize.label.description: Label of the field holding a word's letters, where the learner adds vowel marks.

player.word.label.description: Accessible label of the word an exercise asks about.

player.wordbank.answer-label.description: Accessible label of the row where the chosen tiles go.

push.reminder.gentle.body.message: Your next lesson is there whenever you are.
push.reminder.gentle.body.description: Push notification body for the gentle reminder.

push.reminder.gentle.title.description: Push notification title: a gentle reminder.

push.reminder.quest.body.description: Push notification body for the quest reminder.

push.reminder.quest.title.description: Push notification title: today's quests are not finished.

push.reminder.streak.body.message: A few minutes today keeps it going.
push.reminder.streak.body.description: Push notification body for the streak reminder.

push.reminder.streak.title.description: Push notification title: the learner has a streak and has not practised today. Select on $days if your language's plural forms need it.

quest.listen-5.description: Daily quest: right answers in listening exercises.

quest.perfect-1.description: Daily quest: a session where every first try was right.

quest.produce-5.description: Daily quest: right answers typed or built in the target language.

quest.story-1.description: Daily quest: read stories to the end.

reports.public.message: Reports go to the course's reviewers as public GitHub issues, without your name or device.
reports.public.description: Shown where a learner can report a problem (a correction, or a claim about their answer) when the app sends reports to the project: says they become public issues and carry no name or device.

review.export.description: Reviewers only: a button that downloads this device's sign-offs in the course as a file for `nabu review apply`. $count is how many.

review.intro.message: Reviewing: sign off what reads right, and mark what does not. Your sign-offs stay on this device until you download them.
review.intro.description: Reviewers only: shown at the top of the sentence list when its review controls are on.

review.looks-right.description: Reviewers only (ADR 0072): a toggle under a sentence in the sentence list. On, the reviewer signs the sentence off; it becomes reviewed once their sign-offs are applied to the course.

review.reviewed.description: Reviewers only: a badge on a sentence or story the course source already marks reviewed.

review.story-looks-right.description: Reviewers only: a toggle under a story's heading that signs off every line of the story at once.

review.unit.description: Reviewers only: a button that signs off every sentence and story in this unit that is neither marked incorrect nor reviewed already.

story.finished.stopped.description: Heading when the learner leaves a story before its end.

story.finished.title.description: Heading when the learner reaches the end of a story.

story.gloss.hint.message: Tap a word to see what it means.
story.gloss.hint.description: Shown in the word-meaning panel before any word is tapped.

story.gloss.label.description: Accessible name of the panel that explains a tapped word.

story.gloss.lemma.description: Before a word's dictionary form, in the meaning of one part of a tapped word whose part is written otherwise (bor in boraman: dictionary form bormoq). The form follows, in the course's language.

story.gloss.none.message: This word has no meaning listed yet.
story.gloss.none.description: Shown in the word-meaning panel when a tapped word has no glossary entry.

story.gloss.part.description: Note next to a meaning that covers only part of the tapped word (e.g. one character of 我哋).

story.gloss.phrase.description: Note next to a meaning that covers the tapped word together with its neighbours.

story.narration.description: Accessible label of a story line no character speaks.

story.transcript.label.description: Accessible name of the region that holds the story's lines as they appear.

story.translation.hide.description: Button under a story line that hides its translation again.

story.translation.show.description: Button under a story line that shows what it means in the learner's language.
